text: 中际旭创公告，公司此前拟以不低于人民币40亿元（含）且不超过人民币80亿元（含）回购股份，回购价格不超过人民币1200元/股（含），用于实施股权激励计划或员工持股计划。截至2026年9月23日，公司已实施完成回购，累计回购565.31万股，占总股本的0.48%，最高成交价944.68元/股，最低成交价806.93元/股，支付总金额49.97亿元（不含交易费用）。
text_en: Zhongji Innolight announced that the company had previously planned to repurchase shares for no less than RMB 4 billion (inclusive) and no more than RMB 8 billion (inclusive), at a repurchase price of no more than RMB 1,200 per share (inclusive), for implementing an equity incentive plan or employee stock ownership plan. As of September 23, 2026, the company had completed the repurchase, having cumulatively repurchased 5.6531 million shares, accounting for 0.48% of total share capital, with a highest transaction price of RMB 944.68 per share and a lowest transaction price of RMB 806.93 per share, with a total payment amount of RMB 4.997 billion (excluding transaction fees).
